text.p: Barcelona president Jose Luis Nunez praised manager Bobby Robson in the wake of Wednesday's European Cup Winners' Cup triumph and blamed the media for putting the Englishman under pressure.

"Robson has had many problems and I always supported him," Nunez said. "Polls and articles haven't allowed him to work in a peaceful atmosphere. He's a very polite man and we haven't had any problems but I know he has suffered."
Robson himself was characteristically evasive when asked if the trophy would win him Nunez's confidence.
"You'll have to ask him," the former England coach replied. "I imagine it will help because not many presidents get a Cup Winners' Cup."
Wednesday's 1-0 victory in Rotterdam over Paris St Germain gave Barcelona a record fourth Cup Winners' Cup title. They now have eight European titles, the same as arch-rivals Real Madrid.
